articleTitle: Determining Employees Preference on Employee Shuttle Bus Attributes: A Conjoint Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Shuttle buses are highly beneficial for employees who report to work daily, as these eliminate the worry of safe and convenient travel. This study integrated the Conjoint Analysis approach using an orthogonal design to determine the most preferred combination of employee shuttle bus attributes for Filipinos of working age. This study utilized the following attributes: types of passenger seats, entertainment, emergency preparedness, and temperature. According to the results, the type of seat is the most important employee shuttle bus attribute for Filipino passengers, as it received the highest score value, followed by entertainment, emergency preparedness, and temperature. Since there is a lack of information related to the research topic, the findings in this study can be used as a point of reference for future academic research to enhance the employee shuttle bus. This study can also serve as a reference for companies selecting shuttle buses for their employees. Furthermore, the study can be extended to passenger preference analysis of commuter buses.

articleTitle: Robust optimization of multi-objective and multi-period emergency materials scheduling considering fairness and timeliness
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The number of cases surged in the early stage of the outbreak of new pneumonia, and the demand for medical materials fluctuated greatly. How to meet the needs of hospitals and transport medical materials to the demand point in time under the uncertain and dynamic environment is an urgent problem to be solved. Firstly, this paper predicts the demand of emergency medical materials based on SEIR infectious disease dynamics model. Secondly, the entropy weight method is introduced to determine the urgency of demand points, ensure the priority of demand points with high urgency, on this basis, a multi-objective and multi-period robust optimization model is established by maximizing the weighted satisfaction rate and minimizing the vehicle routing problem. Finally, the emergency medical material scheduling in Wuhan is taken as an example. The results show that the optimization model can improve the fairness and timeliness of emergency materials distribution to a certain extent, and effectively alleviate the impact of demand dynamics and uncertainty on the scheduling scheme, it is of great significance to the dispatch of emergency materials under the epidemic situation.

articleTitle: Design of Intermodal Logistics Network Structure Under Different Hub Failure Scenarios by Rail and Public Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The hub-and-spoke network is currently one of the most important network structures in modern logistics, and its network performance depends mainly on the hub. Natural disasters, man-made destruction, labor disputes and other events can cause unpredictable impacts on hub facilities, which in turn can result in corresponding economic losses and subsequent higher transportation costs. Therefore, we establish different backup hub models under the risks of partial and complete hub disruption, and calculate the backup hubs and the corresponding generated logistics networks under different failure scenarios through example analysis, and analyze and compare the various network costs such as path replacement cost and time cost. Therefore, this paper can provide certain decision-making analysis for the government. If suitable alternative hubs can be selected for important hub nodes in the early stage, it can make a rapid response in the event of disruption.

articleTitle: The Influence of Driving Conditions on the Temperature of Key Components of Fuel Cell Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The thermal management of the key parts of fuel cell vehicles is very important for the stable operation, but the influence of variable driving conditions on the temperature of the key parts of the vehicles is not clear. This paper analyzes the composition of the thermal management system of fuel cell vehicles and the thermal management strategies commonly used at present, and takes a fuel cell passenger car as an example to study the influence of China light-duty vehicle test cycle(CLTC-P), low-speed climbing condition and high-speed climbing condition on the temperature of the key parts of the vehicle. The results show that the temperature difference of different parts of the vehicle in CLTC-P is not obvious, however the temperature difference of different parts of the vehicle in low speed climbing and high speed climbing is larger than that in CLTC-P.

articleTitle: Parking Situation Analysis and Hotspots Identification of Shared Bicycles
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: As a low-carbon transportation mode, dockless bicycle sharing plays a crucial role in urban transportation. However, the tidal phenomenon of shared bicycles and the imbalance between supply and demand have brought many problems to users, shared bicycle enterprises, and urban managers, such as disorderly parking, difficulty in borrowing and returning bicycles. This study is based on the data from the bicycle sharing system in the Huli and Siming districts of Xiamen. After data preprocessing, the Geohash algorithm is used to match shared bicycles with electronic fences to analyze whether the parking location is within the boundary range. Then, the HDBSCAN algorithm is used to cluster parking areas. Finally, based on the retention quantity and retention density, the parking hotspots are identified and the characteristics of these areas are analyzed. The relevant results provide reference for the management department to achieve efficient and standardized operation of shared bicycles.

articleTitle: Road Traffic Retrograde Monitoring and Warning System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Vehicle retrogradation is one of the top ten road traffic offences and poses a serious threat to driving safety. Currently, retrograde monitoring measures suffer from untimely warnings, high costs and high manpower consumption. This study designs a new road retrogradation monitoring and warning system for urban roads, using an RP-L resistive pressure-sensitive sensor and an STM32F407 chip, combined with one-way physical speed bumps, capable of monitoring vehicle retrogradation and providing a multi-dimensional real-time alert warning effect. Information about the breach is transmitted remotely via the internet to the main control center and evidence of the breach is retained. The system is capable of real-time monitoring, timely warning and multi-dimensional alerting, even if the driver is in a state of inattention such as drink-driving or fatigue driving. The system makes up for the shortcomings of traditional retrograde monitoring systems and has strong compatibility and scope for development and promotion.

articleTitle: Forecasting Commercial Vehicle Demand Using a Multiple Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to develop predictive equations and explore the elements that are having an effect on the demand for commercial vehicles in Thailand. The Consumer Price Index (CPI), the Business Sentiment Index (BSI), the price of diesel fuel, and the desire for electric cars were all factors that were considered while compiling this information from a database of newly registered automobiles. Multiple regression analysis, consisting of a linear model and a quadratic model, was utilized to investigate how the presence of a variety of influences influenced the demand for commercial cars. Both the Consumer Price Index and the relationship between the CPI and diesel fuel costs were shown to have a considerable impact on the demand for commercial vehicles. This was the case regardless of which factor was considered first. It was determined that there was a connection between these two parameters of 74.96% after doing the necessary calculations.

articleTitle: Long-term Consistent Simulation of Car-following Behavior in Autonomous Driving Test Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Traffic modeling is crucial for simulation tests of autonomous driving. High-fidelity and low-complexity traffic models facilitate traffic simulation for effective and efficient simulation test results. Recent works have shown the effectiveness of data-driven car-following models with various neural networks. In the pursuit of model accuracy, the complexity of the model increases. However, high-complexity models restrict large-scale traffic simulation, and the simulated car-following behavior may not guarantee long-term consistency with naturalistic driving data. Based on the analysis, we pointed out that the accumulation of model errors over time during simulation is the reason for the inconsistency. To deal with it, a loss-modified training method is proposed, to improve the long-term consistency without increasing the complexity of the model. Experiments conducted on real-world datasets demonstrate that the Loss Modified training method significantly improves the long-term consistency of car-following models and avoids abnormal speed during simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Matching Method of Expressway Emergency Plan Based on CBR and Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Since expressway emergencies are likely to result in significant casualties and property losses, it is critical to investigate the matching technology of emergency plans. To address the issues of subjectivity and low accuracy in current plan matching, this paper proposes an expressway emergency plan matching method based on CBR and rough set. To begin, a plan matching process is designed using CBR technology, and the implementation results are evaluated and fed back, allowing the plan database to be incrementally learned better. Then, with the goal of plan retrieval in mind, a method to determine the weight of plan index based on rough set theory is proposed, which incorporates plan evaluation feedback into the calculation of knowledge granularity and accuracy to improve index weight accuracy. Finally, experiments are performed to validate the effectiveness of the weight calculation method, and the overall similarity of the emergency plan is calculated by combining the similarity of four types of attributes, which can provide accurate matching emergency plan reference for expressway emergencies.

articleTitle: Life cycle assessment of emission reduction potential of private electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Compared to internal combustion engines(ICEVs), electric vehicles (EVs) have an entirely different propulsion system. Encouraging EVs is a crucial step toward bettering the air. Yet, the impact of EVs on reducing emissions has been hotly debated, and the findings of previous research are still up for debate. Using the Model 3 and Volkswagen as examples, this paper measured the energy consumption and emissions of EVs and ICEVs throughout their life cycles using GREET2021, in order to precisely assess the private EVs’ ability to reduce emissions when compared to ICEVs. The variation in CO2 and pollutant emissions between the two vehicle types was also examined. The results show that an EV uses 29.72% less energy and emits 23.06% less CO2 per 100 kilometers than an ICEV. This is in accordance with the power combination currently in use in China. According to the findings, EVs’ CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions per 100 km are lowered by 23.6% within China’s present power mix, and its energy consumption per 100 km is decreased by 29.72 % t when compared to ICEVs. The study also found that the power grid structure is a key factor affecting the amount of emissions from electric vehicles. With the improvement of the power grid structure and the increase of the full life cycle driving range, electric vehicles will have more and more advantages in emission reduction.

articleTitle: Influence of track irregularity on train hunting motion at speeds of 300~400km/h
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Most of the existing studies focus on the influence of track irregularity on the overall performance of vehicle systems, and rarely involve the influence of track irregularity on hunting movement. The system dynamics model of high-speed train with hunting critical speed range of 300~400km/h is established, and the actual hunting frequency range of high-speed train at this speed is 2~21Hz. Three groups of track irregularity wavelength range are divided according to actual hunting frequency range. The amplitude coefficient of track irregularity wavelength is scaled to study the influence of track irregularity wavelength and amplitude on high-speed train hunting motion. In order to further refine the sensitive wavelength range of track irregularity, unimodal harmonic track irregularity is used as the system excitation, and the harmonic frequency range is 2~21Hz. Combined with the above analysis, it is concluded that the sensitive wavelength range of track irregularity that has a significant impact on hunting motion at the speed of 300~400km/h is 7~56m. Finally, the influence of track irregularity on hunting movement is summarized.

Author Keywords: China’s high-speed railway ballastless track irregularity spectrum

articleTitle: Newsvendor Model-based Vehicle Renting Strategy for Logistics Companies during Online Shopping Promotion Seasons
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The promotion season leads to a sharp increase in express parcels, causing the original vehicles of logistics companies to be unable to meet the transportation demand. Renting vehicles from outside is a way to ease transportation supply and demand, but most existing methods focus on transportation efficiency and ignore the profits of logistics companies. This paper proposes a vehicle renting method based on the newsvendor model, which can determine the renting quantity and renting duration of vehicles with different capacities. The research helps logistics companies predesign vehicle renting strategies to get more profits.

articleTitle: Enhancing Self-Driving Capabilities: A Design Architecture Leveraging Sensor Systems and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: This paper endeavors to accomplish Level 4 and Level 5 self-driving by devising a design architecture for cloud-based self-driving vehicles. It incorporates a hybrid positioning navigation method [24, 25] and diverse sensing systems [9, 5, 7, 27] to capture precise environmental information, along with Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors and wheel odometry to complement other sensors and improve positioning accuracy and stability [26, 27, 25]. The architecture utilizes a combination of Vehicular Ad hoc Network (VANET), Internet of Vehicles (IoV), and in-vehicle millimeter wave systems for high-level information communication [9, 8]. To enable real-time monitoring, analysis, and application of vehicle data, the architecture leverages cloud computing, particularly the Amazon Web Services (AWS) platform [10, 11], and takes into account data security risks. The research in this paper is important for promoting the development of autonomous driving technology and provides valuable references for research and practical applications in related fields.

articleTitle: Optimizing Freight Transport Modelling and Supply Chain Logistics for Efficient Goods Transportation from China to North America: A Case Study of Viva Robotics
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: In today’s globalized market, efficient goods transportation plays a pivotal role in the success of businesses, especially for companies like Viva Robotics, a virtual enterprise specializing in floor-sweeping robots. This paper presents a comprehensive case study focused on optimizing freight transport modelling and supply chain logistics to enhance the transportation of goods from China to North America. Leveraging Viva Robotics as the research object, we investigate the challenges and opportunities in the logistics and supply chain domain while exploring innovative solutions to improve efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Carbon Price Prediction based on EMD-BiLSTM-ATTENTION model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: A one-step forward forecasting test for carbon market pricing is done in this work, in which data from the first seven trading days is used to anticipate the price on the eighth trading day. The study compares the MAE, MSE, and RMSE values of several forecasting models and discovers that combining empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and forecasting models yields the best results. It was shown that the hybrid model can improve both the durability and accuracy of carbon price estimates. In terms of forecasting, the combined EMD-BiLSTM-ATTENTION model beats other comparator models, and carbon price forecasting errors in Hubei and Fujian are smaller than those in Shenzhen due to their more stable frequency amplitudes. Nevertheless, it has been discovered that estimating the carbon price in Shenzhen is more difficult due to higher amplitude variations, resulting in higher prediction errors. Overall, the findings indicate that the proposed EMD-BiLSTM-ATTENTION model is appropriate for carbon price prediction, and the study includes carbon market price prediction maps for Shenzhen, Hubei, and Fujian.

articleTitle: Soft Drink Business in Thailand: Supply Chain Analysis and Recommendations for Operational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: As the soft drink market is highly competitive, companies adopt different strategies to cater to consumer needs and increase market share. Our study employs IDEF0 and SCOR models to analyze the supply chain of a large soft drink company in Thailand. The production and maintenance departments face challenges, such as inadequate pure water production processes and insufficient spare parts inventory management. To overcome these issues, we recommend implementing a spreadsheet program to optimize tap and groundwater use and establishing a spare parts inventory system, starting from demand planning, ABC analysis, and proper inventory policy selection for spare parts replenishment. These solutions would reduce inventory costs, increase service levels, and minimize breakdown time. Additionally, we suggest using the FMEA tool to analyze machine operations and adjust maintenance programs for efficient performance.

Author Keywords: The Supply Chain Operations Reference model

articleTitle: Study on the path of improving the supply chain performance of Chinese aviation manufacturing industry in the context of Industry 4.0 technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The concept of “Industry 4.0” has set off a new wave of technological revolution in the field of industrial manufacturing, which has a great impact on the international industrial field. China’s manufacturing industry is facing the problems of urgent time and arduous task in the process of “Industry 4.0” transformation and upgrading. This paper constructs a relationship model of the impact of “Industry 4.0” technology on the supply chain performance of an aerospace manufacturing company in China and introduces structural equation modeling to empirically analyze the proposed path hypothesis. The research results show that: additive manufacturing, blockchain, cloud computing and IoT technologies have a significant positive impact on supply chain integration and customer satisfaction; supply chain integration has a significant positive impact on customer satisfaction; supply chain integration plays a mediating role between the four dimensions of “Industry 4.0” technologies and customer satisfaction. Accordingly, the key path of supply chain performance improvement of an aviation manufacturing enterprise in China is constructed, which is an important guidance for the supply chain transformation and upgrading of aviation manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of Evolutionary Game Model between Government and Cold Chain Logistics Enterprises based on Carbon Trading1
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: In order to explore the influencing factors of carbon emission reduction of cold chain logistics enterprises under the carbon trading mechanism and solve the problem of high carbon emissions in the process of using vehicles by cold chain logistics enterprises, this paper constructs an evolutionary game model with the government and cold chain logistics enterprises as the main players. The results show that: (1) Among the many factors affecting the use of new energy refrigerated vehicles by cold chain logistics enterprises, fresh-keeping efforts and subsidies play a key role; (2) When the government’s share of the cost of new energy refrigerated vehicles becomes larger, the cold chain logistics enterprises will choose new energy refrigerated vehicles faster; (3) When the carbon trading price increases, it will prompt cold chain logistics enterprises to choose new energy refrigerated vehicles and the government’s supervision will be enhanced.

articleTitle: Application of MBSE in the Construction of Smart Factory Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Logistics system is one of the key parts in intelligent manufacturing system, the construction of logistics system in smart factory is a big challenge. In this paper, a forward design methodology based on Model-Based Systems Engineering specifically applicable to the construction of logistics system in smart factory is explored in detail.

articleTitle: Optimization research on closed-loop supply chain network under carbon trading
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: To realize the optimization of a closed-loop supply chain network with carbon trading, a multi-objective mixed-integer linear programming model that comprehensively coordinated economic benefits, carbon emission, and social responsibility was proposed, to solve a multi-tier closed-loop supply chain network problem, including facility type selection and (re)manufacture. Two models are established according to whether they consider carbon trading and the objective functions of economic and environmental goals connected through quota-based carbon trading when the model considers carbon trading. Then, NSGA-II is used to solve two models and verify the effectiveness of the two models and the method’s feasibility via test problems. Finally, some suggestions are provided for closed-loop supply chain network design based on the sensitivity analysis of parameters relevant to carbon trading.

articleTitle: Research on the location of shared bicycle parking points based on the combination of NSGA-II and entropy weight TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Aiming at the location of shared bicycle parking points, considering the constraints such as the amount of shared bicycles, the number of shared bicycle parking points, and the capacity of each parking point, the site selection planning model of shared bicycle parking points is established with the goal of minimizing the construction operating costs of shared bicycle enterprises and minimizing the travel costs of travelers, and the NSGA-II coupled entropy weight TOPSIS algorithm is used to solve it. The case results show that the combination of the two algorithms can determine the optimal site selection scheme when the needs of shared bicycle parking and pick-up are met, and the construction operating costs of shared bicycle enterprises have a greater impact on the comprehensive objective function value, reaching 0.6051.

articleTitle: A game study on low-carbon transportation behavior considering government subsidies
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: This study addresses the issue of selecting low-carbon transportation behavior by using evolutionary game theory to examine how the government can use subsidies to encourage both automobile enterprises and customers to choose low-carbon transportation modes. First, an evolutionary game model is constructed that includes the government, automobile enterprises, and customers, and then its stability is analyzed. Finally, numerical simulations are carried out to explore the factors that influence the outcomes. The research findings show that the government’s customer subsidy strategy can increase the willingness of automobile enterprises to adopt low-carbon transportation by up to 50%. The double income parameters of the automobile enterprises have a significant positive impact, while the cost parameters have a significant negative impact. Subsidies are found to be more effective than non-subsidy methods. The government should prioritize subsidizing public low-carbon transportation and give priority to subsidizing automobile enterprises while ensuring that the critical value of automobile enterprises’ profits is met as much as possible. The method of subsidizing automobile enterprises or customers can be appropriately adjusted through income parameter changes. These findings provide important theoretical and practical guidance for developing low-carbon traffic behavior strategies.

articleTitle: Mobility Patterns before, During and after the COVID-19 Pandemic in Singapore
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Human mobility has been significantly affected by COVID-19 and associated travel restrictions imposed by government policies. This study examines changes in mobility patterns in Singapore during different stages of the pandemic using mobile phone data. Our results indicate that population mobility decreased over the COVID pandemic and is slowly increasing after the restrictions were lifted. However, there have been changes in the mobility patterns of the population. Despite the easing of COVID-19 measures, the population is making fewer trips and the trip distances are longer for some people. This change may be attributed to several factors. One of which is that the population has not quite come back to the pre-COVID working routine and has adopted a semi-work-from-home policy, where the staff is working in the office for a few days a week. The other factor is the habit of making more “purposeful” trips remains. Further, we investigate changes in mobility patterns among the classified explorers and returners. The results demonstrate that the change in mobility has a similar trend to the population as a whole. These observed changes in mobility patterns may become the new normal and should be taken into account for traffic management, business decision-making, policy-making, and urban or transport infrastructure planning.

articleTitle: Changes in Travel Trends and Preferences of Filipinos due to the COVID-19-19 Pandemic: A Conjoint Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The pandemic significantly affects the tourism industry due to health risks and travel conditions. The study aimed to identify the travel preference of Filipinos amidst the pandemic through Applied Conjoint Analysis. Several attributes such as Location, Ambiance, Pre-Departure COVID-19-19 Test, Quarantine Requirements, Insurance Policy, and Type of Tour were analyzed simultaneously. A total of 61 Filipinos answered an online questionnaire which was distributed by a convenience sampling approach. The results demonstrate that Quarantine requirements are an essential attribute that influenced the decision of Filipino travelers. The study can be used for future studies about travel trends due to the pandemic.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Technological Innovation Path of the International Ecological Maritime Cluster of Hainan Free Trade Port
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Based on the current situation of shipping construction and development of Hainan Free Trade Port, drawing on the evaluation indicators of relevant shipping development reports, combined with the strategic development positioning of Hainan Free Trade Port, this paper formulates 2 first-level indicators, 6 second-level indicators and 18 third-level evaluation indicators, and uses EViews software to analyze the principal component of the number of indicators, and then uses SPSS software to further analyze the results of the principal components Cluster analysis was carried out, and the conclusion that Hainan Free Trade Port could learn from the London International Shipping Center for intelligent technological innovation. Finally, this paper combines the SMART rule to formulate a set of operable, quantifiable and measurable intelligent technological innovation paths for Hainan Free Trade International Ecological Maritime Cluster.

articleTitle: Conception of a Holistic System Model for Effective Technical Innovations Integration Applied to 5G Positioning Feasibility Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Continuous improvement and effective integration of innovations are a key factor when enabling automation in logistics. 5G positioning is one of these novel innovations providing precise positioning for a variety of use cases. In order to benefit from these innovations, however, a model for integrating novel technologies into the production system is needed. Current approaches struggle with the issue that there is a complex set of influences harming the project in the sense of achieving the defined project targets – such as time for integration or stakeholder satisfaction. This contribution aims to analyze these approaches and concept a holistic system model for effective technical innovation integration. The goal is to reduce and manage the complexity by an active steering of the main influencing factors to benefit the overall project efficacy. The analysis is based on a structured literature review, followed by expert interviews for most important influences and approaches for a solution design. The derived Systems Model of technical Innovation Development (SMID) is then presented in detail and finally applied on the innovation example of the 5G positioning.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Distribution Characteristics and Influencing Factors of Logistics Enterprises in Shaanxi Province Based on GIS and GeoDetector
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The distribution Characteristics of regional logistics resources are influenced by the spatial distribution of logistics enterprises, which in turn affects the fair distribution of regional logistics resources. This paper based on the data of 7981 logistics enterprises above designated size in Shaanxi Province, to explores the spatial distribution characteristics of logistics enterprises in Shaanxi Province in 2006, 2014, and 2021 by using the methods of Nearest Neighbor Index and Kernel density estimation in ArcGIS, and analyzes the main factors affecting the spatial distribution of logistics enterprises by using GeoDetector. The research shows that the overall spatial distribution of logistics enterprises in Shaanxi Province presents clustering characteristics and the degree of clustering continues to increase, with a more obvious polycentric feature; There are significant differences in the spatial distribution of logistics enterprises of different sizes, with the uneven characteristics converging with the differences in local economic development, resource endowment, and industrial base; The spatial distribution of logistics enterprises in Shaanxi Province is affected by multiple factors from five dimensions: production, consumption, industry, transportation, and society.

articleTitle: Optimizing Dynamic Warehouse Location Problems Using a Stochastic Search
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic warehouse location problem is considered. A Tabu search algorithm (TSA) is proposed to solve the problem. The procedure is tested on three generated benchmark problems. The small-sized problem includes 25 customers, 3 potential warehouse locations, and 3 planning horizon periods. The medium-sized problem consists of 50 customers, 5 potential warehouse locations, and 5 periods of the planning horizon. The large-sized problem consists of 100 customers, 10 potential warehouse locations, and 10 periods of the planning horizon. The proposed algorithm was compared with a solution method for mixed-integer linear programming in a cloud, CPLEX. The proposed algorithm provides reasonable solutions, while CPLEX could not provide solutions for medium and large problems in the limited computation time.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Quality Coordination Based on Blockchain Concept under Deterministic Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: This article constructs a supply chain decentralized decision-making model, a centralized decision-making model, and a supply chain quality coordination model under a revenue sharing transfer payment combination contract based on the blockchain concept. It analyzes the impact of the blockchain concept on the quality level and revenue of the supply chain, and solves the problem of constructing a manufacturer and retailer composition for the model. Finally, the relevant conclusions are verified through simulation analysis and comparison. Research has found that revenue sharing transfer payment contracts are more coordinated. The study in this article hasnot yet considered the impact of other core concepts of blockchain on the quality coordination mechanism of the supply chain, and further research is needed.

articleTitle: Measuring Transport Accessibility in Urban Cities: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Access to public transportation has become crucial in establishing and analyzing the mobility and sustainability of the transit system. Apart from the transportation system itself, the perceived accessibility of public transportation considerably impacts life satisfaction. However, even though public transit is to lower the external cost of driving a private vehicle successfully, many urbanites do not use it, and many residents have limited or no access to public transportation. Governmental policy should enhance the quality of life of the most vulnerable population segments and eliminate social isolation. In addition, the accessibility gap between zones persisted, and the distribution remained unequal despite improvements. In conclusion, those accessibility metrics are frequently suited to a particular place or activity by a specific set of individuals; nonetheless, no one has explored a system that examines all accessibility characteristics.— besides integrating various public transportation modes or introducing new public transport services resulted in different approaches representing impacts, scales, and viewpoints. Hence, as a specific planning decision, various methods are needed.

articleTitle: Predicting Maintenance Contract Service Renewals using the Internet of Things and Customer Behaviors: A Supplier Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The contract terminations for the provision of maintenance services to the tenants of the managed mall affected our organization’s planning, strategy, operations, and revenue. Being able to predict the contract renewals, prevention and readiness plans can be made. Using the data from the computer-aided facilities management (CAFM) software and the available research papers about customer behaviors; the contract renewal outcomes were predicted. In this paper, the operations data of 47 mall tenants (customers) that operates different types of retails were utilized. The data by performance, satisfaction, asset condition and relationship based on the review of the previous studies were categorized. Binary logistic regression was utilized to test the data. The results showed that communication was the strongest influencer to the customers’ behaviors in service contract renewals more than price, satisfaction, and experience. When we understood how to interpret and use the data from the internet of things (IoT), it helped suppliers not only to predict the renewal outcomes, but also build a strategic customer retention program by using the significant variables identified.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index System of Informatization Service Level of Comprehensive Transportation Hub
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: In order to improve the transportation advantages and combination efficiency of the comprehensive transportation hub, the indicators of its information service system are analyzed and screened from four aspects: the degree of information construction, information management means, information service level, and the operation efficiency of transportation facilities, and an evaluation system of the information service level of the comprehensive transportation hub is constructed. The analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method are used to evaluate the single mode of transportation, and the Hongqiao hub is taken as an actual case to carry out the evaluation research on the informatization service level of the comprehensive transportation hub. The research results show that the selected evaluation index system can effectively reflect the informatization level of the comprehensive transportation hub, and the evaluation results are in line with the reality. It is of great significance to measure and improve the informatization service level of integrated transportation hubs, and can provide a basis for the evaluation of the informatization construction of integrated transportation hubs.

articleTitle: Optimization decision of multi-agent collaborative combination scheme of emergency logistics based on NSGA-II and TOPSIS algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Collaborative decision-making for emergency logistics scheme under disaster is a prerequisite activities of emergency logistics. In the case of multi-agent, multi-scheme, multi-resource and time-critical, how to give consideration to both individual and collaborative performance to achieve the established goals in the decision-making process is the current problem to be solved. Based on this, considering that the individual and collaborative performance, this paper constructs a multi-scheme and multi-agent collaborative decision-making model for emergency logistics to minimize operating costs, maximize the satisfaction levels and overall effectiveness. meanwhile, the NSGA-II algorithm is introduced for solving to find the Pareto optimal solution set, while the TOPSIS decision theory is used to comprehensively evaluate all the combination solutions in the Pareto solution set to come up with the best compromise solution. Finally, the cased study is applied to verify the rationality and feasibility of model, and the results show that the optimal compromise scheme meets the requirements of low cost, high demand satisfaction rate and good implementation effect. This study provides a basis for multi-objective collaborative decision making in the field of emergency logistics, and provides new ideas and means for multi-objective collaboration, preference of the combination scheme in scheme decision making research.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Input of Transportation Logistics Land and the Performance Output of Different Logistics Hubs Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: At present, the economy of China has changed from a high-speed growth stage to a high-quality development stage. Integrate the existing logistics infrastructure resources, give better play to the scale economy effect of logistics hub, promote the reform of logistics organization mode, and improve the overall operation efficiency and modernization level of logistics. It is conducive to making up the shortcomings of logistics infrastructure, expanding the supply of high-quality logistics services, building a low-cost and efficient national logistics service network, and improving the vitality and competitiveness of the real economy. Select the 32 key cities in China that the Warehousing in Cloud focuses on, and the 32 key cities carry different types and functional positioning of the national logistics hub. In order to compare the input of transportation logistics land and the performance and output of different types of logistics hubs based on DEA, the data of 32 cities are used as the sample of decision-making units. Firstly, the selection and analysis of input and output indicators are carried out. Secondly, using the data of 32 cities as the sample of decision-making unit, the normality test and correlation analysis of the above input and output indicators are carried out. From the perspective of correlation, the land for logistics storage is related to the land for road traffic facilities. The land for road traffic facilities is related to the added value of the secondary industry, the total retail sales of consumer goods, the import and export volume of goods, and the cargo and mail throughput of the airport. The land for logistics and storage is related to the total retail sales of consumer goods and the import and export volume of goods. Based on the analysis of BCC model of DEA, it is found that from the comparison of the sample cities of different cities’ transportation and logistics land input and the performance output of the production-oriented national logistics hub, Foshan City and Shijiazhuang city are strongly effective in DEA, while other cities are non DEA effective. From the comparison of the sample cities of different cities’ transportation and logistics land input and the performance output of commercial and trade national logistics hub, it can be seen that Shanghai, Hefei and Shijiazhuang are the most efficient DEA cities, while the rest are non DEA cities. From the comparison of the sample cities of transportation and logistics land input in different cities and the performance output of the airport type national logistics hub, it can be seen that Shenzhen is the most efficient city in DEA, while other cities are non DEA efficient. From the comparison of the sample cities of transportation and logistics land input in different cities and the performance output of the inland port type national logistics hub, Shijiazhuang is the only city where DEA is strong and effective, while other cities are non DEA effective. From the comparison of the sample cities of transportation and logistics land input in different cities and the performance output of the port type national logistics hub, it can be seen that Shenzhen, Suzhou and Ningbo are highly effective in DEA, while the rest of the cities are non DEA effective. The corresponding return to scale analysis also gives the direction and trend that the return to scale will change under different production scales of different logistics hub carrying cities.

articleTitle: Efficient allocation of CO2 allowance in liner companies based on a zero sum gains data envelopment model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: The marine emission trading system can effectively reduce the overall carbon emissions of shipping industry at the macro level. However, previous studies on the emission reduction of shipping companies did not solve the problem of annual emission allowance allocation of liner companies from the perspective of technical efficiency. In this paper, the zero sum gains data envelopment model (ZSG-DEA model) is used to propose a most efficient emission allowance allocation mode between eight liner companies with high fleet capacity share based on the data in 2021. The main contributions of this study are as followed:(l) finding that large liner companies, which should have more outstanding performance in emission reduction, still have the demand for emission reduction. (2) The effectiveness of ZSG-DEA model for emission allowance allocation in shipping industry is presented, and the most efficient way of allocation for eight liner companies is obtained through case analysis. The CO2 allowance of all the liner companies reach the ZSG-DEA frontier.

articleTitle: Measuring the TOD level of rail transit stations based on the “node-place-activity” dimension
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: While Transit Oriented Development (TOD) is widely practiced worldwide, there are few quantitative studies on the level of TOD development in rail station areas in the Chinese urban context. In this paper, we use hierarchical clustering to measure the TOD development level of 278 rail transit stations in 3 dimensions in Shanghai, extending the conventional “node-place” model by incorporating activity performance aspects. The findings demonstrate that compared to traditional models, the third dimensional indicator can assist researchers in making more precise distinctions between various levels of TOD development, including 7 types of typical station areas: future TOD, suburban TOD, imbalanced TOD, urban periphery TOD, special stations, urban center TOD and urban core TOD. In addition to promoting the synergistic integration of transportation planning and land use, our research results also provide quantitative guidance for optimizing the TOD development of existing stations and guiding the TOD development patterns of future stations, which can also serve as a foundation for the development of corresponding transportation policies.

articleTitle: The Vehicle-based Service Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Traffic and Logistic Engineering (ICTLE)
abstract: Vehicles can be considered as mobile platforms that enable the provision of public services like education, healthcare, or energy without stationary infrastructure. In particular, rural regions across sub-Saharan Africa demand for such flexible solutions as demand is scattered across vast regions, making investments in fixed facilities economically infeasible. Nevertheless, before entering a new region, vehicle fleet operators require an estimate of the costs in relation to the addressable demand to validate the investment case. This paper introduces a novel cost model for heterogeneous vehicle-based service systems. The proposed mixed integer programming problem considers strategic, tactical, and operational planning decisions that determine the cost of supplying a target area with a set of services provided by a fleet of vehicles. To test the proposed model, we apply it to a case study in Ethiopia for three public services. Based on the results, fleet operators gain insights into the fleet size, fleet mix, and associated operating costs.
